featured_reviews.name: Maj Manish Kar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been getting spectacles made from Navrang Optics, Chandivali for past three years. I owe this review to Navrang Optics and has been due for quite some time now.

So one fine day in the recent past, I decide to get my annual eyes checked from an Ophthalmologist and go to Navrang, while selecting a frame, I end up loving an Oakley - a large frame which I generally prefer with photochromic lens. Upon delivery, and use of one day, I realised the lenses is not suiting me and I approach Navrang and they told to meet the doctor. I approached the doctor who informed that the large frame is making the lense not suitable for my use. I again went back to Navrang and informed them about the wrong frame recommended to me. They conduct a Eye Test and identify that the doctor's prescription has a diagnosis error.

I again met the doctor and he reconducted the diagnosis and confirmed as per Navrang's diagnosis and passed it on to some changes in my physiology - now this sounded unlikely and did not take any responsibility.

I approached another doctor as a second opinion and it met Navrang's diagnosis. Dinesh at Navrang was very supportive, he approached the owners and got me a substantial waiver for the new lense. The new lense fitted in the same Oakley frame which is perfectly fine for me now. In this entire chayos, Dinesh & Rizwan from Navrang both were very patient and accommodating in handling my situation.

This is my first experience where the doctor, forget taking responsibility, did not even acknowledge his mistake / error in judgement causing extreme financial loss, mental agony and harassment but Navrang owners, Dinesh & Rizwan were very supportive and is extremely appreciated my family and me.

Thank you Navrang Owners, Dinesh & Rizwan.
